ROUTE STATUS: apply.qahighereducation.com is a HYPOTHESIS from search results, not a
verified fact. Confirming or refuting it is the first job of this run.
The eight AUTH claims are the questions ADR-0020's chooseApproach refuses to run without.
They decide whether AskiMate ever holds a credential to this student's university account.
Four of them (2, 3, 7, 8) cannot be answered by reading pages — they need someone to try
the flow on a portal we are permitted to try it on, which is what the sandbox request is for.
routeNotes: Ulster Birmingham is a branch campus: validated by Ulster University, taught by QA Higher
Education. Admissions therefore run on the teaching partner's systems, NOT on Ulster's own
Banner portal (srssb.ulster.ac.uk). Verifying this is the primary objective.
claimsToVerify: Applications for the Birmingham campus are handled at apply.qahighereducation.com, not by Ulster's own system
The portal platform is Salesforce Experience Cloud
Whether an account must be created before the application form is visible
Applicants must be 18 at course start (RELEVANT TO ADR-0011/0013 — verify before relying on it)
Required documents: transcripts, certified translations, English test certificate
Whether the September 2026 intake is open and its deadline
Whether the application form is reachable without an account, or hidden behind a login
Where the submission control is, and what endpoint it posts to
Whether any fields are conditional on earlier answers
AUTH 1/8: Does the applicant choose their own password at account creation?
AUTH 2/8: Does the portal generate a credential and send it to the applicant?
AUTH 3/8: Does the portal offer passwordless sign-in — a magic link, an emailed code, or similar?
AUTH 4/8: Must the email address be verified before the application form is reachable?
AUTH 5/8: Is MFA or a one-time code required at any point?
AUTH 6/8: Is a CAPTCHA present, and on which pages?
AUTH 7/8: Does 'Forgot password' work, and does the reset go to the account's own address?
AUTH 8/8: Can control be handed back cleanly — no lingering session, no second factor bound to us?
